# 🔐 Security Policy

The canonical security policy for this repository is maintained in the repository-root [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md). It describes the supported source scope, private vulnerability-reporting route, in-scope concerns, existing controls, known limitations, and contributor expectations.

**Report a potential vulnerability privately** through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Brajesh31/chatbot-C-/security/advisories/new). Do not publish credentials, private data, or exploit details in a public issue.

For ordinary bugs, documentation corrections, and feature requests, use the public issue forms. Security-sensitive reports must follow the canonical root policy.
